text: Rescoped 2026-09-22 as the single hygiene ticket for construction probes. Acceptance: (1) a tools/ script lists every test file using typeChecks/typeCheckErrors whose quoted fully-qualified guarded types lack a real (non-string) reference in the same file, and exits nonzero if any are found; (2) add the anchors until it passes; (3) one incremental-mutation demonstration per module shows that the anchored probe now fails without a clean.
